tenantId.description: Xero tenant ID from list_connections. Omit for Custom Connections.

page.description: Xero page number for paginated endpoints.

where.description: Advanced Xero where filter expression, e.g. Status=="AUTHORISED". Prefer the explicit filter fields when available.

order.description: Xero order expression, e.g. UpdatedDateUTC DESC.

modifiedAfter.description: Only include records modified after this RFC3339 timestamp.

status.description: Convenience status filter for endpoints that support a Status query parameter.

contactIds.description: Filter invoices/transactions to one or more contact IDs from list_contacts.

invoiceNumbers.description: Filter invoices by invoice number. For invoices, line items are returned by Xero when invoice numbers are supplied.

fromDate.description: Convenience start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format for date-based resources.

toDate.description: Convenience end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format for date-based resources.

includeArchived.description: Whether to include archived records when the endpoint supports it.
